sections.title: 1. Data Model & DAX Preparation
items: Import the star-schema tables: Sales (Fact), Calendar (Date dimension), Products, Geography, Salesforce, and Customers.
Create measure: [Scorecard Title] = "SALES SCORECARD"
Create measure: [Total Sales] = SUM(Sales[SalesAmount])
Create measure: [Profit] = SUM(Sales[ProfitAmount])
Create measure: [CY Sales] = CALCULATE([Total Sales], DATESYTD(Calendar[Date]))
Create measure: [PY Sales] = CALCULATE([Total Sales], SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR(Calendar[Date]))
Create measure: [Sales Growth Pct] = DIVIDE([CY Sales] - [PY Sales], [PY Sales])
Create measure: [CY Profit] = CALCULATE([Profit], DATESYTD(Calendar[Date]))
Create measure: [PY Profit] = CALCULATE([Profit], SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR(Calendar[Date]))
Create measure: [Profit Growth Pct] = DIVIDE([CY Profit] - [PY Profit], [PY Profit])
Create measure: [Is Profitable] = IF([Profit] >= 0, 1, 0)

sections.title: 2. Page & Header Assembly
items: In Power BI Desktop, set Page Size to 16:9 (1280 x 720 px) and Canvas Background to #F4F5F7 (0% transparency).
Add report header text box or card 'SALES SCORECARD' at (X: 20, Y: 15, W: 420, H: 65) with status legend indicators (Unprofitable: #FF5A5F, Profitable: #718096).
Insert Slicer for Customers[Segment] at (X: 970, Y: 15, W: 140, H: 65) with vertical list style.
Insert Slicer for Calendar[Year] at (X: 1125, Y: 15, W: 135, H: 65) with vertical list style.

sections.title: 3. Volume & Regional Visuals
items: Insert Clustered Bar Chart 'How are we performing by Product?' at (X: 20, Y: 95, W: 290, H: 150). Set Y-axis to Products[Product], X-axis to [Total Sales], and apply conditional bar color formatting using [Is Profitable].
Insert Clustered Bar Chart 'How are we performing by Region?' at (X: 20, Y: 260, W: 290, H: 175). Set Y-axis to Geography[Region] and X-axis to [Total Sales].

Insert Clustered Bar Chart 'How are we performing by State?' at (X: 325, Y: 95, W: 315, H: 340). Set Y-axis to Geography[State], X-axis to [Total Sales], and apply conditional bar color formatting using [Is Profitable].

sections.title: 4. Comparative Trends & Matrix
items: Insert Line Chart 'What is our Sales Trend?' at (X: 655, Y: 95, W: 605, H: 255). Set X-axis to Calendar[Month], Y-axis to [CY Sales] and [PY Sales]. Turn Data labels On and configure title subtitle callout.

Insert Matrix 'Where are we losing money?' at (X: 20, Y: 450, W: 620, H: 255). Set Rows to Products[Product Category], Columns to Geography[Region] and Salesforce[Regional Manager], and Values to [Profit].
Configure Matrix Cell Elements: apply Background Color conditional formatting with rule: IF [Profit] < 0 THEN #FF5A5F.

Insert Line Chart 'What is our Profit Trend?' at (X: 655, Y: 365, W: 605, H: 340). Set X-axis to Calendar[Month], Y-axis to [CY Profit] and [PY Profit]. Turn Data labels On and configure title subtitle callout.

acceptance: Segment and Year slicers successfully cross-filter all 6 data visuals.
Unprofitable products, states, and matrix cells consistently display the coral red (#FF5A5F) warning color.
Line charts correctly display both Current Year and Prior Year data points with clear visual hierarchy.
Matrix table columns display regional hierarchy with assigned regional managers.
Canvas layout conforms precisely to the 1280 x 720 spatial grid without overlapping or truncated visuals.
